checklist_snapshot.changeSummary: PRP Master Checklist v2.0 — initial managed version.

sections.title: Understanding and Context
sections.intent: The policy must clearly state what it governs, who it applies to, and why it exists.

items.text: The policy states a clear purpose and objective in the Purpose section.
The intended audience is explicitly identified.
The scope is defined in the Applicability section, including what is covered and what is excluded.

sections.title: Clarity and Language
sections.intent: The policy must be written in plain, consistent, and unambiguous language appropriate for its audience.

items.text: The policy uses plain, unambiguous language throughout.
Language is appropriate for the intended audience.
Consistent terminology is used across all sections.
The policy is free of contradictory or conflicting statements.
The writing style is consistent with other Osool policies.
The policy conforms to Osool's standard language and communication approach.

sections.title: Completeness and Structure
sections.intent: The policy must follow Osool's standard structure, carry a valid document code, and include all mandatory sections.

items.text: A definitions or glossary section is present and includes all technical terms and acronyms used in the policy.
References to supporting procedures are included.
Access and distribution controls for the document are defined.
Retention period for the policy and its records is stated.
The official Osool Policy Template has been used, ensuring consistent structure and formatting.
A General Provisions section is present covering communication, training, onboarding, monitoring, and accountability for the policy.
The policy document code follows Osool's naming and coding convention.
The policy does not contain procedural detail. Step-by-step procedures, forms, and operational instructions are kept in the supporting procedure manual.

sections.title: Policy Necessity and Strategic Alignment
sections.intent: The policy must have a clear rationale and must be aligned to Osool's strategic objectives.

items.text: The rationale for why this policy is necessary is documented.
The policy is aligned to and contributes to Osool's current strategic and operational objectives.
The policy identifies the business functions responsible for its implementation.

sections.title: Accountability and Ownership
sections.intent: A named policy owner must be identified. Approval authority must be stated. Access controls must be defined.

items.text: A named policy owner is identified.
The approval authority and authorized signatories for the policy are clearly stated.
Responsibilities for each role are explicitly defined, not implied.
Authorities are assigned at appropriate levels.
Senior management demonstrates commitment to and accountability for the policy's effectiveness through formal approval.
Restricted or confidential policies are identified, accessible only to authorized parties, and require Governance Function approval for third-party access.
The policy does not declare specific approval authorities or thresholds. Approval authorities are referenced through the Delegation of Authority (DoA), not duplicated in the policy.
The policy ensures appropriate segregation of duties so that no single individual controls all phases of a critical process (e.g., requesting, approving, executing, and verifying).
The policy requires individuals involved in decisions made under it to disclose actual or potential conflicts of interest, in line with Osool's Conflict of Interest Policy.

sections.title: Escalation and Approval
sections.intent: The policy must state how breaches are escalated and how approvals are obtained.

items.text: The escalation path for breaches or non-compliance is explicitly stated.
Approval and sign-off processes are outlined.
The authority to make final decisions on unresolved matters is identified.

sections.title: Oversight and Compliance
sections.intent: The policy must state monitoring mechanisms, list applicable laws, state consequences of non-compliance.

items.text: The policy states that monitoring mechanisms are in place.
Applicable laws and regulations are listed.
Consequences of non-compliance are clearly stated.
The policy commits to a corrective action process for non-compliance.

sections.title: Policy Need Assessment
sections.intent: The basis for establishing or updating this policy must be documented.

items.text: The basis for establishing, updating, or retiring this policy is documented.

sections.title: Measurable Objectives
sections.intent: Policy objectives must be measurable, have a named responsible party, a target, and a review frequency.

items.text: Objectives relevant to this policy are stated.
Each objective is measurable and has a defined target.
Each objective has a named responsible party.
Each objective has a target completion date or review frequency.
The policy states that objectives will be monitored and their achievement evaluated.
Required resources to achieve objectives are identified.

sections.title: Transparency and Communication
sections.intent: The policy must define what is communicated, to whom, at what frequency, and through which channels.

items.text: The policy defines what information will be communicated, to whom, and at what frequency.
Communication channels are defined for both internal and external communications.
The policy is made readily available to all in-scope employees through Osool's internal electronic channels.
It is mandatory for employees in scope to be aware of this policy.

sections.title: Training and Awareness
sections.intent: Competency requirements must be stated. Training must be required. Staff must be aware of non-conformance implications.

items.text: Competency requirements for roles implementing this policy are stated.
The policy requires training for all affected staff.
New employees are required to be onboarded on this policy.
The policy states that staff shall be aware of the implications of not conforming to it.

sections.title: Policy Lifecycle and Review
sections.intent: The policy must state its effective date, version, owner, and review cycle.

items.text: The effective date of the policy is stated.
A version number and version history are included.
A named owner for the review process is identified.
The policy states that it will be updated when regulatory, operational, or strategic conditions change.
The policy review cycle is at least once every three years as per the Metapolicy.

sections.title: Metrics and Performance Measurement
sections.intent: The policy must define KPIs, monitoring responsibility, reporting frequency, and a feedback loop for improvement.

items.text: The policy states that KPIs for measuring its effectiveness are defined.
The frequency of measurement and reporting is stated.
Responsibility for monitoring and reporting is assigned.
The policy commits to a feedback loop to inform improvement based on measurement results.

sections.title: Benchmarking and Standards
sections.intent: The policy must reference applicable regulatory and industry standards.

items.text: The policy identifies applicable industry, regulatory, and international standards or frameworks.

sections.title: Cross-Functional Areas
sections.intent: All in-scope functions must be identified with their roles defined.

items.text: All departments and functions in scope are identified.
The role and responsibility of each function is defined.

sections.title: Requirements and Stakeholder Communication
sections.intent: Requirements must be determined, documented, and communicated. Statutory and regulatory requirements must be identified.

items.text: The policy states that a process for communicating requirements to stakeholders exists.
Requirements relevant to this policy are determined and documented.
Statutory and regulatory requirements relevant to this policy are identified.

sections.title: Stakeholder Sign-Off and Endorsement
sections.intent: A formal approval record must exist at the appropriate authority level.

items.text: A formal endorsement or approval record exists at the appropriate authority level per the Delegation of Authority.

sections.title: Interdependency with Other Policies
sections.intent: All referenced policies must be listed in the References section.

items.text: All policies this policy depends on or references are listed.
Potential conflicts or overlaps with existing policies have been reviewed.
Cross-references to related policies are included within the document.

PRP1-1.comment: Section 1.1 (Purpose) sets out objectives explicitly and references the strategic intent of orderly asset disposal.

ref.quote: This policy establishes the principles and authority for the disposal of digital city assets owned or controlled by Osool, in order to maximize realisable value, ensure transparency, and maintain regulatory compliance.

PRP1-2.comment: Applicability section names the in-scope entities clearly.

ref.quote: This policy applies to all Osool subsidiaries, joint ventures, and special-purpose vehicles holding digital city assets, including authorised representatives acting on their behalf.

PRP1-3.comment: Inclusions are present but the policy does not enumerate exclusions. Add a 'Not in scope' subsection covering leased and pre-development assets.

ref.quote: This policy applies to all Osool subsidiaries, joint ventures, and special-purpose vehicles holding digital city assets…

PRP2-1.comment: Language is concise across §3–§7. A small number of long sentences in §6.4 could be split for readability but do not impede meaning.

ref.quote: "Digital city asset" means any parcel, building, or development right registered under Osool's Digital City master registry.

PRP2-2.comment: Vocabulary aligns with the audience of asset managers and divisional heads.

ref.quote: Terms such as 'disposal', 'reserve price', and 'fair market value' are used with definitions and align with internal terminology.

PRP2-3.comment: 'Reserve Price', 'Floor Price' and 'Minimum Bid' are used interchangeably in §6.2, §6.4, and §8.1. Standardise on one term and update Definitions.

ref.quote: §6.2: "the Reserve Price set by the Pricing Committee"  …  §8.1: "the Floor Price shall not be disclosed to bidders".

PRP2-4.comment: No direct contradictions detected. One borderline tension between §5.3 (manager-led disposals) and §7.1 (Committee approval) is reconciled by the DoA reference.

ref.quote: §5.3 authorises managers to initiate disposal; §7.1 confirms approval flows through DoA thresholds — interpretation is consistent.

PRP2-5.comment: Comparison against Osool's policy library requires human judgement — passed to reviewer.

PRP2-6.comment: Style adherence assessed by Organizational Excellence — human verification required.

PRP3-1.comment: Definitions cover 14 terms. Verified against in-document usage — no orphan acronyms detected.

ref.quote: Defined terms include: Digital City Asset, Reserve Price, Disposal Committee, DoA, Fair Market Value, PSF, Letter of Intent, …

PRP3-2.comment: §11 references three procedure manuals; cross-reference document codes resolve.

ref.quote: OSOOL-RE-PROC-014-A Disposal Execution Manual; OSOOL-RE-PROC-014-B Pricing & Valuation Procedure; …
Classification: Internal.

PRP3-4.comment: No retention period stated. Add a clause referencing the Records Management Policy with a minimum 10-year retention for disposal records.

PRP3-5.comment: Template compliance requires visual inspection against the OEC Master Template — human verification.

PRP3-6.comment: §10 General Provisions covers all five required elements with named responsible parties.

ref.quote: Communication, training, onboarding, monitoring, and accountability obligations for this policy rest with the Real Estate Investment Division, supported by HR and OE.
Document Code: OSOOL-RE-POL-014  ·  Version 1.3  ·  Effective 01-Jun-2026

PRP3-8.comment: §6.3 contains a 9-step disposal procedure that belongs in the procedure manual, not the policy. Move steps to OSOOL-RE-PROC-014-A and keep only the principle.

ref.quote: Step 1 — Asset is flagged for disposal in the registry. Step 2 — Pricing Committee assigns a Reserve Price. Step 3 — Marketing pack is produced within 10 business days. …

PRP5-1.comment: Strategic rationale assessment requires human judgement.

PRP5-2.comment: Strategic alignment is reviewed by OE leadership.

PRP5-3.comment: §4 RACI identifies Real Estate Investment Division as accountable, with Finance and Legal as consulted.

ref.quote: Accountable: Real Estate Investment Division.  Responsible: Asset Disposal Unit.  Consulted: Finance, Legal, Internal Audit.  Informed: OE.

PRP6-1.comment: Policy owner is named on the cover and in §4.

ref.quote: Policy Owner: Head of Real Estate Investment Division.

PRP6-2.comment: Approval flow references the Board Investment Committee with signatories.

ref.quote: Approved by the Board Investment Committee on 12 April 2026. Signatories: Chairman, CEO, Head of OE.

PRP6-3.comment: §4 RACI is explicit with named role responsibilities per stage.

ref.quote: Each role has a one-line responsibility statement covering initiation, valuation, approval, execution, and post-disposal reporting.

PRP6-4.comment: Authority-level appropriateness must be assessed by the reviewer against DoA.

PRP6-5.comment: Approval record includes signatures from C-suite.

ref.quote: Approved by the Board Investment Committee … Signatories: Chairman, CEO, Head of OE.

PRP6-6.comment: Classification is set to Internal; access list and third-party approval gate documented.

ref.quote: Third-party access to this policy or its disposal records requires written approval from the Governance Function.

PRP6-7.comment: §7.2 specifies SAR-value thresholds for managerial approval that duplicate the DoA. Remove monetary thresholds and reference the DoA instead.

ref.quote: Disposals up to SAR 5,000,000 may be approved by the Division Head; above this, by the Investment Committee.

PRP6-8.comment: §4 explicitly separates initiator, approver, executor, and verifier.

ref.quote: No single role may both approve a disposal and execute the sale or transfer instructions.

PRP6-9.comment: §4.3 references the Conflict of Interest Policy with mandatory disclosure.

ref.quote: All participants in a disposal decision shall disclose actual or potential conflicts of interest as required by OSOOL-GOV-POL-002.

PRP7-1.comment: §9.2 sets a three-tier escalation path with timelines.

ref.quote: Tier 1: Unit Head within 5 business days. Tier 2: Division Head within 10 business days. Tier 3: OE and Internal Audit within 15 business days.

PRP7-2.comment: Approval steps reference the DoA with sign-off responsibilities.

ref.quote: All disposals shall be approved in accordance with the Delegation of Authority. Sign-off is recorded in the Disposal Register.

PRP7-3.comment: The Board Investment Committee is identified as the final decision authority.

ref.quote: The Board Investment Committee is the final decision-making authority for any matter unresolved at Tier 3.

PRP8-1.comment: §9.1 commits to quarterly monitoring with named owners.

ref.quote: Compliance with this policy shall be monitored quarterly by Internal Audit and reported to the Audit Committee.

PRP8-2.comment: Legal team must verify completeness of cited regulations.

PRP8-3.comment: §9.4 states disciplinary consequences and reporting to HR.

ref.quote: Non-compliance may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination, and shall be reported to HR and Internal Audit.

PRP10-1.comment: Version history records the trigger for v1.3 (Vacant Asset Disposal regulation, Q4 2025).

ref.quote: v1.3 (May 2026): Updated to incorporate new MOMRA regulation on vacant asset disposal and to align with Osool's revised pricing framework.
(i) maximise realisable value; (ii) ensure transparency; (iii) maintain regulatory compliance; (iv) accelerate disposal of vacant assets.

PRP11-2.comment: Measurability and targets require business-context assessment.

PRP11-3.comment: Objective (iv) does not name a responsible party. Assign to the Vacant Asset Disposal Unit.

ref.quote: (iv) accelerate disposal of vacant assets — [responsible party not named].

PRP11-4.comment: No completion dates or review cadence stated for any objective.

PRP11-5.comment: §9.1 commits to monitoring; evaluation is implied by quarterly reporting.

ref.quote: Compliance and objective achievement shall be reviewed quarterly by Internal Audit.

PRP11-6.comment: Resource requirements (headcount, systems, budget) are not specified.

ref.quote: A communication matrix shall identify the audience, content, channel, and frequency for all policy-related communications.

PRP16-2.comment: Internal (Osool intranet, email) and external (Tadawul, MOMRA filings) channels are listed.

ref.quote: Internal channels: Osool intranet, departmental email. External channels: regulatory filings to MOMRA and disclosures via Tadawul.

PRP16-3.comment: Policy will be published on the Osool Policy Portal upon approval.

ref.quote: This policy shall be made available to all in-scope employees through the Osool Policy Portal.

PRP16-4.comment: Availability is stated but mandatory awareness is not. Add a clause: 'All in-scope employees are required to read and acknowledge this policy.'

PRP18-1.comment: Roles are named but minimum qualifications or experience levels are not stated.

PRP18-2.comment: §10.3 mandates annual training delivered by L&D.

ref.quote: All in-scope staff shall complete annual training on this policy delivered by Learning & Development.
New hires in scope shall complete this training within 30 days of joining as part of onboarding.
Non-compliance may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
Effective Date: 01 June 2026.
v1.0 (Jul 2023), v1.1 (Mar 2024), v1.2 (Nov 2024), v1.3 (May 2026) with change summaries.
The Head of Real Estate Investment Division is responsible for triggering and coordinating reviews.

PRP20-4.comment: §11 commits to ad-hoc updates upon trigger events.

ref.quote: This policy shall be reviewed at a minimum every three years, or earlier when regulatory, operational, or strategic conditions change.
… reviewed at a minimum every three years …

PRP21-1.comment: §9 mentions 'performance indicators' but does not define them. Recommend at least 3 KPIs: time-to-dispose, value realised vs reserve, audit findings.

ref.quote: Performance indicators shall be tracked — [KPIs are not enumerated].
Reporting frequency: quarterly to the Audit Committee.
Internal Audit is responsible for monitoring and reporting.

PRP21-4.comment: No formal feedback or continuous-improvement loop. Add a clause linking findings to the policy review process.

PRP22-1.comment: Benchmarking completeness requires sector expertise — human verification.

ref.quote: In scope: Real Estate Investment Division, Asset Disposal Unit, Finance, Legal, Internal Audit, Organizational Excellence.

PRP23-2.comment: Each function has explicit RACI assignments.

ref.quote: RACI matrix covers Initiation, Valuation, Approval, Execution, Verification, and Reporting.
Stakeholders shall be informed of new and changed requirements via the communication matrix.
Requirements covering eligibility, pricing, governance, conflict of interest, and reporting are set out in §5.

PRP24-3.comment: References mention MOMRA but do not enumerate articles or include Capital Market Authority obligations relevant to disclosure.

ref.quote: References include MOMRA Vacant Asset Regulation, 2025 — [no specific articles cited; CMA disclosure rules not referenced].

PRP28-1.comment: DoA-level appropriateness must be confirmed by the reviewer.

PRP29-1.comment: §11 lists all dependent policies with document codes.

ref.quote: OSOOL-GOV-POL-002 Conflict of Interest; OSOOL-FIN-POL-007 Valuation; OSOOL-GOV-POL-012 Delegation of Authority; OSOOL-RM-POL-009 Records Management.

PRP29-2.comment: Cross-policy conflict review is a human task.

ref.quote: e.g., §4.3 cross-references OSOOL-GOV-POL-002; §7 cross-references OSOOL-GOV-POL-012.

approval.note: Two minor gaps flagged with CAP.

strengths: Comprehensive RACI with explicit segregation of duties (§4)
Strong escalation and approval flow with named final authority
